note: hour==5 naive-calc boundary run (04:26 UTC = 05:26 BST Sat): IS_CLOSURE_WINDOW formula literally false (hour=5 fails <5), so this is outside the closure band by the stored formula. But 05:26 BST sits in the documented transition gap -- Fri/Sat Night Tube ends 05:00, standard Saturday service nominally opens 05:30 -- so neither the closure-window table entry nor the standard-hours table entry alone would justify treating the network as fully open. Per established live-check-overrides-naive-calc precedent (see data-capture-pipeline-notes.md, 00:30-cutoff and hour==5-boundary cases), queried live status directly instead of trusting the table: ALL registry lines (13 main + 4 river-bus boats) returned real, substantive statuses (Good Service / Part Closure / Planned Closure on waterloo-city) -- none were Service Closed placeholders -- so the network is in practice already running the full Saturday day service a few minutes early. Treated OPERATING_LINES as the full registry based on this live check and wrote all 19 returned lines (6 individually-named overground lines -- liberty, lioness, mildmay, suffragette, weaver, windrush -- returned by the overground mode query, superseding the single overground-windrush registry label; same category of registry-label-vs-TfL-reality gap as the elizabeth/windrush id corrections already on record).
